column1: # The checks of shell/outside-form-set-password.nsh. See check-shell-log.sh.
# A PASSWORD outside any form set, which edk2's Config Keyword Handler finds, could keep its
# password in any variable, so get, list-questions, show-ifr and set read and write none, even
# with --i-am-fine-to-brick-this-system, and nothing shows a byte of the password "Outside"

column3: . == {"error_message": "PASSWORD op of package list 8C78A505-BAA0-4C4A-869F-000000001B00 outside a FormSet, at offset 0 of a form package, which no Forms Browser shows but edk2's Config Keyword Handler finds; as the variable of that password is unknown, the UEFI Shell build reads and writes no variable of this HiiDB"}
